title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student correctly identifies that a particle and its antiparticle must have the same mass by selecting option (a).

title: Understanding of Antiparticles
description: Important Criteria: The student demonstrates an understanding of the relationship between particles and antiparticles beyond just mass.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student provides a clear rationale for why the selected answer is correct, referencing symmetry.

title: Consideration of Other Options
description: Optional Criteria: The student briefly discusses why the other options (b) and (c) are incorrect.

title: Common Misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student mistakenly claims that particles and antiparticles can differ in mass or attributes, leading to an incorrect answer.
